policy: Manually reviewed alternatives only. Official sources establish a relevant use case, not feature parity or drop-in compatibility. Discovery and accuracy checks propose changes for review; they never populate this file or the README automatically.

alternatives.name: Jira
alternatives.scope: Project management and issue tracking. The official page explicitly positions OpenProject as a Jira alternative.

alternatives.name: NotebookLM
alternatives.scope: AI-assisted research notebooks. The official README explicitly positions Open Notebook as an alternative to Google Notebook LM.

alternatives.name: Terraform
alternatives.scope: Declarative infrastructure as code. The official migration guide supports moving Terraform configurations to OpenTofu, with backups and plan verification; compatibility must be checked for the specific configuration.

alternatives.name: Vellum
alternatives.source_quote: Vellum delivers on the same core promise
alternatives.scope: Personal AI assistants with persistent memory and task execution. User-requested mapping supported by Vellum’s official comparison, which positions Vellum as an alternative to OpenHuman; this is not an OpenHuman-authored claim or a claim of feature parity.

alternatives.name: Hermes Agent
alternatives.source_quote: OpenHuman vs Other Agent Harnesses
alternatives.scope: Personal AI agent harnesses. OpenHuman’s official README directly compares Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, and OpenHuman across memory, orchestration, workflows, and integrations. Hermes Agent is the NousResearch agent application, not a Hermes language model.

alternatives.name: OpenClaw
alternatives.source_quote: OpenHuman vs Other Agent Harnesses
alternatives.scope: Personal AI agent harnesses. OpenHuman’s official README directly compares OpenClaw and OpenHuman across memory, orchestration, workflows, and integrations; the comparison does not establish drop-in compatibility.

alternatives.name: Claude Cowork
alternatives.scope: Desktop AI agents working on local files and reusable workflows. The official project source explicitly supports this alternative; feature parity and universal compatibility are not claimed.
alternatives.source_quote: OpenWork is the free, open-source alternative to Claude Cowork and Codex

alternatives.name: Codex
alternatives.scope: Desktop AI-agent work on the user's files; no claim of complete Codex product-family parity. The official project source explicitly supports this alternative; feature parity and universal compatibility are not claimed.

alternatives.name: Screen Studio
alternatives.source_quote: OpenScreen is a free, MIT-licensed Screen Studio alternative
alternatives.scope: Screen recording and editing product demos with zooms, cursor effects, captions, and local video export. The official comparison distinguishes Screen Studio's hosted sharing and mobile-device capture; it does not establish feature parity.

alternatives.name: Camtasia
alternatives.source_quote: OpenScreen is a free Camtasia alternative
alternatives.scope: Screen recording and timeline editing for demos and walkthroughs. The official comparison excludes Camtasia's quiz/SCORM, caption-file delivery, and direct publishing workflows; native Camtasia project compatibility is not claimed.

alternatives.name: Figma
alternatives.source_quote: OpenPencil is the alternative
alternatives.scope: Visual interface design and editing. The official README's Why section explicitly names Figma before positioning OpenPencil as the alternative and links to current compatibility gaps. This applies only to open-pencil/open-pencil, not the unrelated ZSeven-W project with the same name.

alternatives.name: HashiCorp Vault Community Edition
alternatives.scope: Secrets, certificates, and key management; replacing a Vault CE server cluster with OpenBao. Guide tested against Vault CE 1.14.1 with Raft storage and Shamir unseal, using OpenBao 2.2.0. Does not establish Vault Enterprise replacement or universal newer-version compatibility.
alternatives.source_quote: migrate a HashiCorp Vault Community Edition cluster to OpenBao.

alternatives.name: Microsoft SharePoint
alternatives.scope: File management, file sharing, and content collaboration; not all SharePoint intranet/application capabilities. The official statement was published on 2025-02-25 and rechecked on the date recorded here; this is not a new announcement or a whole-suite replacement claim.
alternatives.source_quote: alternative to proprietary solutions such as Microsoft SharePoint, Google Drive or Dropbox.

alternatives.name: Google Drive
alternatives.scope: File management, file sharing, and content collaboration; not all Google Workspace. The official statement was published on 2025-02-25 and rechecked on the date recorded here; this is not a new announcement or a whole-suite replacement claim.

alternatives.name: Dropbox
alternatives.scope: File management, file sharing, and content collaboration. The official statement was published on 2025-02-25 and rechecked on the date recorded here; this is not a new announcement or a whole-suite replacement claim.

alternatives.name: CapCut
alternatives.source_quote: The open-source CapCut alternative
alternatives.scope: Video editing. The official repository's About statement explicitly positions OpenCut as a CapCut alternative. Its current README says a rewrite is underway and directs users to the classic version; this does not establish current feature parity or readiness of the rewrite.

alternatives.name: Codex
alternatives.source_quote: If you previously used Codex, inspect both homes during migration:
alternatives.scope: Terminal coding-agent workflows. The official guide describes moving Codex setup into Open Interpreter and reviewing configuration, hooks, permissions, and sessions. This concerns the current Rust CLI, not the legacy Python Code Interpreter project, and does not promise all configuration or session compatibility.

alternatives.name: VMware
alternatives.scope: Enterprise virtualization and private-cloud VM workloads. Use VMware as the first-party label; do not infer replacement of every VMware product.
alternatives.source_quote: Ready to replace VMware with OpenNebula?

alternatives.name: Datadog
alternatives.scope: Observability for logs, metrics, traces, and frontend monitoring. Alternative claim, not an assertion of complete Datadog feature parity.
alternatives.source_quote: alternative to Datadog, Splunk, and Elasticsearch

alternatives.name: Splunk
alternatives.scope: Observability and log analytics. Do not extend this to every Splunk security or enterprise workflow.

alternatives.name: Elasticsearch
alternatives.scope: Observability/log analytics workloads, rather than every Elasticsearch search use case. README frames the claim around observability.

alternatives.name: Mixpanel
alternatives.scope: Web and product analytics. The official project source explicitly supports this alternative; feature parity and universal compatibility are not claimed.
alternatives.source_quote: An open-source alternative to Mixpanel

alternatives.name: Google Analytics
alternatives.scope: Website analytics; README comparison table specifically labels GA4. The official project source explicitly supports this alternative; feature parity and universal compatibility are not claimed.
alternatives.source_quote: one of the best Google Analytics replacements.

alternatives.name: Elasticsearch
alternatives.scope: Search and analytics engine workloads migrated to OpenSearch. Source-version and feature limitations apply; do not present as universal drop-in compatibility.
alternatives.source_quote: moving data, metadata, and live traffic from Elasticsearch

alternatives.name: Apache Solr
alternatives.scope: Search engine workloads; documents/schema migration followed by application cutover to OpenSearch. Backfill only; no live-traffic Capture and Replay. Applications must change their query layer. Solr plugins require replacement/reimplementation. Official overview and detailed page disagree on target OpenSearch version coverage, so no target-version guarantee is made.
alternatives.source_quote: Once confident, point your application directly at OpenSearch.

alternatives.name: DocuSign
alternatives.scope: Document e-signing. The official project source explicitly supports this alternative; feature parity and universal compatibility are not claimed.
alternatives.source_quote: alternative to commercial esign platforms like DocuSign, PandaDoc, SignNow

alternatives.name: PandaDoc
alternatives.scope: Document e-signing only, not the entire document automation suite. The official project source explicitly supports this alternative; feature parity and universal compatibility are not claimed.

alternatives.name: SignNow
alternatives.scope: Document e-signing. The official project source explicitly supports this alternative; feature parity and universal compatibility are not claimed.

alternatives.name: UptimeRobot
alternatives.scope: Uptime monitoring and associated status pages. Do not copy unverified comparative pricing or region-count marketing into the alternatives entry.
alternatives.source_quote: openstatus is the UptimeRobot alternative worth considering.

alternatives.name: Better Stack
alternatives.scope: Uptime monitoring and status pages. Not a replacement claim for Better Stack's log management or full incident-escalation product suite.
alternatives.source_quote: openstatus is the BetterStack alternative to consider.

alternatives.name: Status.io
alternatives.scope: Hosted status pages and incident communication. Openstatus adds monitoring, but shared replacement scope is status pages.
alternatives.source_quote: Looking for a Status.io alternative with built-in monitoring?

alternatives.name: Sunsama
alternatives.scope: Daily planning with task organization, time blocking, and focus workflows. The official README explicitly answers that it is a Sunsama alternative. This mapping does not adopt its licensing marketing or establish feature parity.
alternatives.source_quote: It covers Sunsama's daily-planning loop

alternatives.name: Wispr Flow
alternatives.scope: Desktop AI voice input and rewriting. The official project source explicitly supports this alternative; feature parity and universal compatibility are not claimed.
alternatives.source_quote: Open-source alternative to Wispr Flow and Superwhisper

alternatives.name: Superwhisper
alternatives.scope: Desktop AI voice input and rewriting. The official project source explicitly supports this alternative; feature parity and universal compatibility are not claimed.

alternatives.name: Typeless
alternatives.scope: Desktop voice typing only; not a replacement for Typeless mobile keyboard. The official project source explicitly supports this alternative; feature parity and universal compatibility are not claimed.
alternatives.source_quote: A Practical Typeless Alternative: OpenTypeless
